# The Pacific Crest Trail · เส้นทางแปซิฟิกเครสต์

> The PCT from Mexico to Canada, 2,650 miles: numbers, a south-to-north photo walk, fire, snow and flood map links, notable years, towns and trail businesses listed for sale (checked 28 Sep 2026), trail traditions, and Burney Mountain Guest Ranch at mile 1411. English and Thai.
